7.13 Error classification
Section "Error Handling" of the document [1] describes the error handling of the Basic Software in detail. Above all, it constitutes a classification scheme consisting of five error types which may occur in BSW modules. Based on this foundation, the following section specifies particular errors arranged in the respective subsections below. The EcuM has an additional handling of errors (see chapter 7.12 ErrorHook).
